deck_title: Enterprise 4K 60fps AI Video Mastering: Bidirectional Optical-Flow Temporal SR + Hann Overlapped-Tile Blend (c_4k = c_0/(1+u), 1.0000x Lock) vs Naive Per-Frame 2D Upscaling Flicker

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Enterprise 4K 60fps AI Video Super-Resolution & Mastering pipeline evaluation (warping 8-frame recurrent features along bidirectional RAFT/GMFlow optical flow, blending 25%-overlapped latent tiles via a 2D Raised-Cosine Hann window, and outputting 10-bit TPDF-dithered ProRes/HEVC so amortized unit cost c_4k(u) = c_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking C_active / C_temporal = 1.0000x across all 17 mastering stages u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive per-frame independent 2D upscaling & non-overlapping tiling (which causes inter-frame texture boiling and visible checkerboard tile seams, inflating rework cost by 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stages) and 64-frame optical-flow tile quadrature.
